title: Senior Automation Engineer
description:
**Assistant Manager \- Automation** 




**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Lead automation design, development, and commissioning activities.
 



 • Manage and mentor a team of Automation Engineers and Service Engineers for
 



 project execution and customer support.
 



 • Develop, troubleshoot, and optimize PLC, HMI, SCADA, and Motion Control
 



 applications.
 



 • Ensure machine automation systems comply with 21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5, and
 



 pharmaceutical validation requirements.
 



 • Support qualification activities including IQ, OQ, PQ, FAT, and SAT documentation.
 



 • Develop audit trails, electronic records, electronic signatures, user access
 



 management, and data integrity features.
 



 • Coordinate with Mechanical, Electrical, Validation, and Production teams for
 



 successful project delivery.
 



 • Interface with customers during design reviews, FAT, commissioning, and
 



 validation activities.
 



 • Drive standardization of software architecture, coding practices, and
 



 documentation.
 



 • Support global installations and site commissioning activities.
 



 Technical Skills Required
 



 • Hands\-on experience in PLC programming: Beckhoff TwinCAT, Siemens, Allen
 



 Bradley, Mitsubishi PLC, Omron PLC, Schneider PLC
 



 • Strong knowledge of: Structured Text (ST), Function Block (FB), Motion Control \&
 



 Servo Systems
 



 • SCADA/HMI Development: WinCC, Ignition, Wonderware / AVEVA, FactoryTalk
 



 View, TwinCAT HMI
 



 • Database Integration: MS SQL Server, MySQL,, MS Access
 



**Qualification** 




 • B.E./B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Automation, or
 



 Mechatronics Engineering.
 



 • 8\-12 years of experience in pharma machine manufacturing or industrial
 



 automation.

title: Vision System Engineer
description:
**Organisation overview:** 




 Agratas is a global battery business within the Tata Group. We’ll design, develop and manufacture high\-quality, high performance, sustainable battery solutions. We’ve entered our industrialization phase, building world\-class battery manufacturing facilities in Sanand, India, and in Bridgwater, UK, unlocking green growth opportunities for global customers in the mobility and energy sectors.
 



  





  





**The Opportunity** 




 We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Vision Systems Engineer to join our dynamic team in the battery manufacturing industry. The candidate will be responsible for designing, development, implementation and maintaining vision systems for automate inspection, measurement, and quality control in battery production processes
 



 The ideal candidate will have a passion for automation and machine vision, with a strong background in engineering and hands\-on experience with vision system integration in a manufacturing environment. The Vision Systems Engineer will be proactive, collaborative, and capable of solving complex technical challenges while maintaining a focus on quality, efficiency, and innovation.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities and Responsibilities** 




  




* Design \& Development of Vision Systems: Lead the design, development, and deployment of vision systems to automate inspection, measurement, and quality control in battery production processes.
* System Integration \& Optimization: Integrate vision systems with existing manufacturing processes, including robotics and automated production lines, ensuring smooth functionality and improved performance.
* Image Processing \& Algorithm Development: Develop and implement image processing algorithms and vision inspection applications using tools such as Keyence, Cognex, OpenCV, C\+\+, and MATLAB to detect defects, measure components, and support automated decision\-making.
* Collaboration with Cross\-functional Teams: Work closely with engineering, quality control, and production teams to ensure vision systems meet production requirements and contribute to process improvements.
* System Calibration \& Maintenance: Calibrate, troubleshoot, and maintain vision systems, ensuring optimal performance and reliability throughout the production cycle.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities for the enhancement of vision systems, proposing and implementing solutions to optimize manufacturing processes, reduce downtime, and improve product quality.
* Data Collection \& Reporting: Monitor the performance of vision systems and analyze production data, providing detailed reports and recommendations for further optimization.
* Documentation \& Training: Develop clear and comprehensive technical documentation, including user manuals, troubleshooting guides, and system specifications. Provide training to operators and team members on vision system usage and maintenance.
* Compliance \& Safety: Ensure vision systems are deployed in line with industry safety standards, operational guidelines, and regulatory requirements.



  





**Knowledge, Skills and Experience** 




  




* Technical Expertise in Vision Systems: Extensive knowledge of machine vision technologies, including camera systems, lighting, optics, image processing, and industrial vision platforms such as Keyence, Cognex, HALCON, OpenCV, and MATLAB.
* Programming Skills: Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, C\+\+, and familiarity with machine learning libraries for vision system applications.
* Manufacturing Experience: Experience in integrating vision systems into automated manufacturing environments, ideally in high\-precision industries such as battery production or electronics.
* Calibration \& Measurement System Analysis (MSA): Experience in vision system calibration, validation, and execution of MSA studies (including MSA1 and MSA3/GR\&R) to ensure measurement accuracy and inspection system performance.
* Troubleshooting and Problem\-solving Skills: Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities to ensure that vision systems function as intended and address challenges quickly.
* Collaboration \& Communication: Ability to work in a cross\-functional team environment, with clear communication skills to liaise between technical teams and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Knowledge of Industry 4\.0 Technologies: Familiarity with smart manufacturing solutions, IoT, and AI\-driven vision technologies is a plus.



  





**Role Specific Qualifications/Certifications** 









* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering, Computer Vision, Robotics, Mechatronics, or a related field 5\+years of work experience.
* Strong knowledge of machine vision systems and hands\-on experience with platforms such as Cognex, Keyence, SICK, or similar.
* Experience in manufacturing environments or automated inspection systems is strongly preferred.
* Knowledge of machine learning and AI applications in vision systems is a plus.

title: Test Automation Handler Engineer
description:
**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for
 *all* 
 .**
 Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
   

  

 Responsible for addressing and improve product and equipment \-specific issues. Collaborating with other Equipment Engineering teams to implement new products and monitor existing products. Serve as the primary point of contact for product\-specific engineering issues and acts as a liaison with outside departments including Manufacturing, Process, TSE, PE, QA and Planning. Liaised with QA group for quality improvement by introducing efficient working method, safety working environment, line audit, equipment health check and process and equipment improvement.
   

  

 Responsibilities and Tasks
   

  

 Evaluate and Improve Assigned Assembly Manufacturing Processes, Materials, and/or Equipment
   

  

* Maintain General process knowledge
* Maintain Equipment knowledge as it relates to the process
* Maintain Materials knowledge as it relates to the process
* Optimize process and/or equipment variables
* Identify all process variables
* Apply DOE techniques
* Perform containment of process and equipment deviations
* Determine root cause
* Implement corrective action
* Maintain knowledge of equipment and materials and how they interact
* Monitor Assembly process SPC and implement working procedures, process specification , FMEA and OCAP for line personnel


 Evaluate Future Process, Equipment and/or Material Technologies
   

  

* Evaluate pertinent technology and engineering advancements relating to equipment, materials and processes
* Locate and research technical information on equipment, materials, and/or processes in journals, literature, web, etc
* Build and maintain effective relationships with suppliers
* Identify supplier’s materials or equipment design and production processes
* Create decision matrix for equipment and material selection


 Coordinate Equipment and/or Material Procurement
   

  

* Maintain knowledge of process, equipment, and material requirements
* Follow equipment safety requirements
* Define quality and performance requirements
* Maintain Kknowledge of procurement document requirements and format
* Follow Micron Capital Equipment Procedures (MICAP)
* Maintain working knowledge of Assembly’s equipment installation procedures
* Set up required inventories for start up (tools, spare parts, materials).
* Maintain knowledge SAP MATREQ (Materials Requisition) program to look up and order spare parts
* Maintain knowledge of equipment tracking programs: ETI (Equipment Tracking Interface), ETReports, ETMaint.


 Develop Process of Record (POR)
   

  

* Define process variables
* Determine major contributing factors or variables and their interactions using DOE techniques
* Define process edges and center the process (CPK)
* Assembly in\-line process control and working towards assembly yield continuous improvement


 Qualify New Process, Equipment and/or Material
   

  

* Define and implement quality systems
* Maintain knowledge of Assembly’s qualification procedures
* Maintain knowledge of Quality and Reliability Assurance (QRA).
* Cost reduction project by working closely with other team member such development group, material and equipment supplier


 Implement New Process, Equipment and/or Material
   

  

* Define and maintain operation, maintenance, and energy isolation procedures
* Review current procedures on an on\-going basis
* Maintain knowledge of Assembly On\-Line Document System (AODS)
* Maintain knowledge of change communication procedures: ECN (Engineering Change Notice), Inbox, emails
* Maintain knowledge of material attributes (shelf life, storage requirements, etc.)
* Ensure materials compatibility with equipment and parameters
* Maintain knowledge of supplier’s constraints
* Maintain knowledge of new chemical/material approval process and MICIS (Micron Chemical Information Systems)


 Coordinate Training Requirements and Conduct Training
   

  

* Develop, or coordinate development of, training materials for existing equipment
* Coordinate and conduct technical training with Engineering and Equipment Support (EES) group
* Conduct training for production trainers
* Train and mentor others


 Contribute to a Safe and Compliant Work Environment
   

  

* Identify and promptly report hazards
* Follow safety procedures and area work rules (including use of proper PPE, energy isolation, and chemical safety)


 Use of Artificial Intelligence in few projects
   

  

* Operate and maintain equipment and tools within manufacturer and company guidelines
* Use proper lifting techniques and work in an ergonomically correct manner
